cohort_population: delivered orders; unique customer; observed purchase month; no proof of full history before extract

scenario.interpretation: Hypothetical incremental merchandise GMV, not profit, guaranteed revenue or measured intervention effect.

limits: Delivery/ratings are observational associations, not causal effects.
Legacy 19-day threshold is exploratory; no confirmatory p-value is claimed.
August 2018 cutoff is an explicit analytical assumption, not proof of source completeness.
GMV excludes freight; BRL is not USD; no margin, cost or profit is available.
